snippet.title: Irondrive - Beta Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Irondrive is a top-down vehicular roguelike where crew management meets base building on wheels, repair systems under fire, cook, smelt and make permanent decisions on a post-apocalyptic road. Your base is moving. Your crew is breaking. Every hit matters. 

- 🎮 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599730/Irondrive/
- 🕹️ Play the Demo on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599730/Irondrive/
- 💬 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/NNWJP6rRAQ

───────────────────────────────
This is a beta gameplay trailer. Features and visuals are subject to change.
